programme.title: E3 - Jill's Art-rageous Makeover
programme.desc: It's makeover time for Artsy August! Give Mom a wild new look with crazy makeup and pink hair. Then, fix your friends' broken items with crafts on the bus, hunt for treasure as a mermaid, and play detective to find a missing bunny!

programme.title: E1 - Baby John's Big Book of Safety!
programme.desc: Open up Baby John's Big Book of Safety & learn along with him! First, the family learns they must remember their helmets to stay safe on a fun family bike ride. Then, it's time for a trip to the beach, where Mom & Dad teach the kids how to have fun & stay safe as they enjoy the sun & sand. The safety lessons continue at the pool, where Baby John learns the importance of following the rules when swimming.

programme.title: E4 - Answering Big Questions!
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs & even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits & vegetables!

programme.title: E3 - Fun Nature Discoveries!
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he & D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made & join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science & new friends!

programme.title: E4 - Cody's Artsy August Craft Corner
programme.desc: Get crafty this Artsy August! Help Cody’s family make a homemade alphabet when their soup is all gone. Then, play with an empty cardboard box, learn about African instruments, make a leaf crown, and form a rock band with your classmates!

programme.title: E3 - Mia & The Bus's Art Day
programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.title: E18 - JJ's Animal Friends & Counting!
programme.desc: Join JJ for fun with animal friends & counting! JJ has to find five little ducks that ran away from their bath! Then, Bear helps JJ search nature to find his missing teddy bear. The animal fun continues as JJ plays hide-and-seek with shark toys, counts baby ducklings at the park & watches ten little dinosaur eggs hatch! Plus, act out the story of the 'Three Little Pigs' & sing along to 'Little Miss Muffet'!

programme.title: E2 - The Whole Crew to the Rescue!
programme.desc: It's the whole crew to the rescue in these amazing adventures! When Kat doesn't know a car's throttle is stuck, she goes for a test drive & is soon out of control, forcing Grandma & Gecko to rescue her! Then, when a beach trip is cancelled because Tilly the Tow Truck breaks down, Trevor helps with a tow & then delivers a load of sand to create a surprise beach right at the garage! Plus, the whole crew jumps into action when Blue gets stranded alone down a steep bank.

programme.title: E1 - When Arpo's Imagination Runs Wild!
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house & needs to be stopped!

programme.title: E2 - From Bathtime to Bedtime Fun!
programme.desc: Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia & Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks & get nice & clean in the tub. After the bath, it's time to get into pajamas & play a fun game of Peek-a-boo with Mummy using lots of different objects from around the house. Finally, it's time for bed as Daddy & Ella take turns giving Max a cuddle & a teddy bear before he goes to sleep. Night night!

programme.title: Linlang
programme.desc: Victor Lualhati, a former boxer turned seaman, discovers signs of his wife Juliana's infidelity and begins a personal investigation. As he digs deeper, Victor uncovers a web of deception involving powerful figures and family secrets, realizing that the affair is only part of a much larger and more dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

E68
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E12 - 刑事辯護律師來襲
programme.desc: 明星助力官繼續傾情加盟，通過快問快答揭秘明星不為人知的經歷和情感往事，以獨特視角助陣男女嘉賓尋找真愛。以星素之間和代際之間的磁場碰撞，解讀當下年輕人的婚戀觀。

programme.title: E1 - 終於把你等來了
programme.desc: 由張純燁、伊能靜、張繼科、朱正廷、宋雨琦、姜振宇等人組成的「戀愛觀察團」，8位年輕男女於雲南大理「浪漫滿屋」合宿一個月，開啟同一屋簷下的合租模式，並於其中彼此之間出現的信號進行推理愛情。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

programme.title: Shanghai Grand
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials...

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'...

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: The story takes place on a deserted island. The only residence on the island is a family in which the mother ruled over three of her sons: Tai Fat, gloomy and sullen; Yee Fat, vulgar and cruel; Sam Fat, slightly retarded. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. Cheung first thinks that it's a joke, but soon senses that Tai Fat is serious and that all three brothers are actually psychologically imbalanced...

programme.title: Fruit Punch
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways...

programme.title: Heart Of Dragon
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him?

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope. Back at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

E14
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。
